<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="7WtDz9g_6gvGG25FCcul"> <mxGraphModel dx="3804" dy="1047" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
title Traffic Timing Decision - Class Diagram

left to right direction

skinparam shadowing false
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam linetype ortho

class HealthReporter <<Health>> {

- cycleStartTimestampNs : uint64_t
- cycleFinishTimestampNs : uint64_t
- executionTimeNs : uint64_t
- deadlineMs : uint32_t
- deadlineStatus : DeadlineStatus
- heartbeat : bool

+ startDecisionCycle() : void
+ finishDecisionCycle() : void

+ generateHealthReport() : HealthReport
+ publishHealthReport() : bool

- recordStartTimestamp() : void
- recordFinishTimestamp() : void
- calculateExecutionTime() : void
- evaluateDeadline() : void

}

class PeriodicService <<RT_Service>> {

- timerFd : int32_t
- periodMs : uint32_t
- running : bool

+ initialize() : bool
+ runDecisionCycle() : void
+ shutdown() : void

}

class TrafficDataReceiver <<IPC>> {

- snapshotQueue : SnapshotQueue
- latestSnapshot : TrafficSnapshot
- previousSnapshot : TrafficSnapshot
- snapshotTimeoutMs : uint32_t
- lastReceiveTimestampNs : uint64_t

+ requestSnapshot() : TrafficSnapshot
+ validateSnapshot(snapshot : TrafficSnapshot) : bool
+ getLatestSnapshot() : TrafficSnapshot
}

class DecisionEngine <<Algorithm>> {
- previousPlan : TimingPlan
- currentScore : DemandScore
- emergencyActive : bool

+ processTrafficMetrics(snapshot : TrafficSnapshot) : TimingPlan
+ detectEmergency(snapshot : TrafficSnapshot) : bool
+ calculateDemandScore(snapshot : TrafficSnapshot) : DemandScore
+ assignGreenTime(score : DemandScore) : TimingPlan
+ generateDraftTimingPlan(score : DemandScore) : TimingPlan
+ setEmergencyFlags(plan : TimingPlan) : TimingPlan
}

class ConstraintManager <<Constraint>> {
- minimumGreenMs : uint32_t
- maximumGreenMs : uint32_t
- maximumCycleLengthMs : uint32_t
- yellowTimeMs : uint32_t
- allRedTimeMs : uint32_t

- validateCycleLength(plan : TimingPlan) : bool
- scaleGreenTime(plan : TimingPlan) : TimingPlan
+ applyTimingConstraints(plan : TimingPlan) : TimingPlan
}

class TimingPlanPublisher <<IPC>> {
- lastPublishedPlan : TimingPlan
- ackTimeoutMs : uint32_t
- lastPublishTimestampNs : uint64_t

+ publishTimingPlan(plan : TimingPlan) : bool
+ publishPreviousTimingPlan() : bool
+ waitAck() : bool
}

class SnapshotQueue <<POSIX_Message_Queue>> {
- mqDescriptor : mqd_t
- queueName : char*
- attributes : mq_attr

+ open() : bool
+ receive(snapshot : TrafficSnapshot&) : bool
+ close() : void

}

struct TrafficSnapshot {

+ frameId : uint64_t
+ timestamp : uint64_t

+ vehicleCountNS : uint32_t
+ vehicleCountEW : uint32_t

+ queueLengthNS : float
+ queueLengthEW : float

+ occupancyNS : float
+ occupancyEW : float

+ emergencyNS : bool
+ emergencyEW : bool

}

struct DemandScore {

+ northSouthScore : float
+ eastWestScore : float
+ overallScore : float

}

struct TimingPlan {

+ planId : uint64_t
+ generationTimestamp : uint64_t

+ greenNS : uint32_t
+ greenEW : uint32_t

+ yellowTime : uint32_t
+ allRedTime : uint32_t

+ cycleLength : uint32_t

+ emergencyNS : bool
+ emergencyEW : bool

}

PeriodicService *-- TrafficDataReceiver : owns
PeriodicService *-- DecisionEngine : owns
PeriodicService *-- ConstraintManager : owns
PeriodicService *-- TimingPlanPublisher : owns

TrafficDataReceiver --> SnapshotQueue : receives snapshots

DecisionEngine --> ConstraintManager : uses

TrafficDataReceiver --> TrafficSnapshot : stores snapshots

SnapshotQueue ..> TrafficSnapshot : transports \n snapshots

DecisionEngine ..> TrafficSnapshot : reads

DecisionEngine --> DemandScore : calculates,\n uses

DecisionEngine --> TimingPlan : creates, stores

ConstraintManager ..> TimingPlan : modifies

TimingPlanPublisher --> TimingPlan : sends, stores

PeriodicService *-- HealthReporter : owns

HealthReporter ..> TrafficDataReceiver : monitors

HealthReporter ..> TimingPlanPublisher : monitors

@enduml",
 "config": null

plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
title Traffic Timing Decision - Class Diagram

left to right direction

skinparam shadowing false
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam linetype ortho

class HealthReporter <<Health>> {

- cycleStartTimestampNs : uint64_t
- cycleFinishTimestampNs : uint64_t
- executionTimeNs : uint64_t
- deadlineMs : uint32_t
- deadlineStatus : DeadlineStatus
- heartbeat : bool

+ startDecisionCycle() : void
+ finishDecisionCycle() : void

+ generateHealthReport() : HealthReport
+ publishHealthReport() : bool
+ logTimingData(&logData) : bool

- recordStartTimestamp() : void
- recordFinishTimestamp() : void
- calculateExecutionTime() : void
- evaluateDeadline() : void

}

class PeriodicService <<RT_Service>> {

 - timerFd : int32_t
 - periodMs : uint32_t
 - running : bool

 + initialize() : bool
 + runDecisionCycle() : void
 + shutdown() : void

}

class TrafficDataReceiver <<IPC>> {

 - snapshotQueue : SnapshotQueue
 - latestSnapshot : TrafficSnapshot
 - previousSnapshot : TrafficSnapshot
 - snapshotTimeoutMs : uint32_t
 - lastReceiveTimestampNs : uint64_t

 + requestSnapshot() : TrafficSnapshot
 + validateSnapshot(snapshot : TrafficSnapshot) : bool
 + getLatestSnapshot() : TrafficSnapshot

}

class DecisionEngine <<Algorithm>> {

 - previousPlan : TimingPlan
 - currentScore : DemandScore
 - emergencyActive : bool

 + processTrafficMetrics(snapshot : TrafficSnapshot) : TimingPlan
 + detectEmergency(snapshot : TrafficSnapshot) : bool
 + calculateDemandScore(snapshot : TrafficSnapshot) : DemandScore
 + assignGreenTime(score : DemandScore) : TimingPlan
 + generateDraftTimingPlan(score : DemandScore) : TimingPlan
 + setEmergencyFlags(plan : TimingPlan) : TimingPlan

}

class ConstraintManager <<Constraint>> {

 - minimumGreenMs : uint32_t
 - maximumGreenMs : uint32_t
 - maximumCycleLengthMs : uint32_t
 - yellowTimeMs : uint32_t
 - allRedTimeMs : uint32_t

 - validateCycleLength(plan : TimingPlan) : bool
 - scaleGreenTime(plan : TimingPlan) : TimingPlan

 + applyTimingConstraints(plan : TimingPlan) : TimingPlan

}

class TimingPlanPublisher <<IPC>> {

 - lastPublishedPlan : TimingPlan
 - ackTimeoutMs : uint32_t
 - lastPublishTimestampNs : uint64_t

 + publishTimingPlan(plan : TimingPlan) : bool
 + publishPreviousTimingPlan() : bool
 + waitAck() : bool

}

class SnapshotQueue <<POSIX_Message_Queue>> {

 - mqDescriptor : mqd_t
 - queueName : char*
 - attributes : mq_attr

 + open() : bool
 + receive(snapshot : TrafficSnapshot&) : bool
 + close() : void

}

struct TrafficSnapshot {

 + frameId : uint64_t
 + timestamp : uint64_t

 + vehicleCountNS : uint32_t
 + vehicleCountEW : uint32_t

 + queueLengthNS : float
 + queueLengthEW : float

 + occupancyNS : float
 + occupancyEW : float

 + emergencyNS : bool
 + emergencyEW : bool

}

struct DemandScore {

 + northSouthScore : float
 + eastWestScore : float
 + overallScore : float

}

struct TimingPlan {

 + planId : uint64_t
 + generationTimestamp : uint64_t

 + greenNS : uint32_t
 + greenEW : uint32_t

 + yellowTime : uint32_t
 + allRedTime : uint32_t

 + cycleLength : uint32_t

 + emergencyNS : bool
 + emergencyEW : bool

}

class Analytics <<Analytics>> {

 - statistics : Statistics
 - histogram : Histogram


 + getLogData(): LogData

 + calculateStatistics() : void
 + generateHistogram() : void

 + printStatistics() : void
 + printHistogram() : void

 + exportHistogram(fileName : string) : bool

}

PeriodicService *-- TrafficDataReceiver : owns
PeriodicService *-- DecisionEngine : owns
PeriodicService *-- ConstraintManager : owns
PeriodicService *-- TimingPlanPublisher : owns

TrafficDataReceiver --> SnapshotQueue : receives snapshots

DecisionEngine --> ConstraintManager : uses

TrafficDataReceiver --> TrafficSnapshot : stores snapshots

SnapshotQueue ..> TrafficSnapshot : transports \n snapshots

DecisionEngine ..> TrafficSnapshot : reads

DecisionEngine --> DemandScore : calculates,\n uses

DecisionEngine --> TimingPlan : creates, stores

ConstraintManager ..> TimingPlan : modifies

TimingPlanPublisher --> TimingPlan : sends, stores

@enduml",
 "config": null
